entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Judy. How can I help you today?
Hi Judy. I'm calling to start a return for a VeloBand Cadence Sensor I recently bought.
Certainly, I can absolutely help you with that. Let me just pull up your account information. Can I get your name, please?
Okay, Alex, I see your account here. And the VeloBand was delivered on December 24th, about 27 days ago. That is well within the **90 days** we allow for returns, so that is **no problem** at all.
Oh, perfect. I wasn't sure what the window was. So, what do I need to do?

I've just processed the request for you. I'm emailing you a prepaid **return label** right now. You should see it in your inbox in a few minutes. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office.
That was incredibly easy. Thank you.

You are very welcome! And Alex, I see you're a VIP member with VeloFit. As a thank you for your loyalty and for trying out the new sensor, I've gone ahead and added a $25 credit to your account for your next purchase with us.
Wow, you didn't have to do that. That's really great service. Thank you so much, Judy.

It's my pleasure. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, you'll see a full refund to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help.
Wonderful. Thanks again for calling VeloFit, and have a fantastic day!
